name: ghost-qa
displayName: ghost-qa — Autonomous Browser QA for Coding Agents
description: Autonomous headless browser QA & self-healing verification loop for AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Windsurf). 8-trap deep browser inspection across Desktop 1440x900, Tablet 768x1024 and Mobile 375x812 in light + dark: console/hydration, network/assets, layout/collision, WCAG a11y + keyboard focus, Core Web Vitals, link integrity, SEO/metadata, theme parity — with a QA Health Score (A+ to F), interactive HTML dashboard, and ghost_qa_compare regression diffing so agents prove fixes before reporting done.

tools.name: ghost_qa_audit_url
tools.description: Run the full ghost-qa Deep Browser Inspection against a running localhost app: crawls internal routes on Desktop 1440x900, Tablet 768x1024 and Mobile 375x812 under light + dark colour schemes, safely exercises interactive controls, and runs the 8-Trap Engine (console/framework runtime, network/asset integrity, layout/geometry/collision, WCAG accessibility + keyboard focus, Core Web Vitals performance, link integrity, SEO/metadata, theme parity). Returns the Self-Healing Bug Report plus QA Health Score (0-100, grade A+ to F).

url.description: Target URL of the running app, e.g. http://localhost:3000

tools.name: ghost_qa_compare
tools.description: Compare two ghost-qa JSON reports and return the Regression & Verification Delta Report: scoreDelta, fixedFindings, newRegressions, remainingFindings. Proves a fix resolved the bug without introducing regressions; verified only at QA Health Score >= 95 with zero regressions.

tools.name: ghost_qa_doctor
tools.description: Verify ghost-qa environment readiness: Node.js version, Chromium binary availability, and a live headless-browser smoke test. Run this first when an audit fails to start.
